description: For hiring plans, headcount plans, and questions about when to open requisitions or how many people to hire as volume grows, shrinks or changes by season. Plans month by month how many requisitions to open so FTE on hand keeps up with FTE needed. A requisition adds capacity only after time to hire and ramp, and attrition removes people every month, so the plan opens reqs ahead of need and flags the months that run short before any new hire can count. Give weekly_volume with monthly_growth (0.05 means 5% a month, compounding), or weekly_volume_by_month. Unknown inputs fall back to stated defaults: current headcount defaults to what month 1 needs, attrition to 0, time to hire to 2 months, ramp to 0. When attrition is assumed, the result also gives the plan at 15% and 30%. Give hires_in_flight for people already hired or in the pipeline. Returns the plan table, totals, the arithmetic, and which inputs were assumed. A hire counts as zero capacity until fully ramped. Hosts that support MCP Apps also draw the plan as a chart with controls that rerun it.

annual_attrition.description: Share of the team that leaves in a year. 0.25 means 25%. Default 0.

current_headcount.description: FTE on the team today. Default: what month 1 needs, rounded up.

hires_in_flight.description: People already hired or in the pipeline, and the month they start counting. These are the only way to cover months before a new requisition can land.

month.description: Plan month the people start counting as capacity. Use 1 for anyone counting from the start.

hours_per_fte_week.description: Paid hours per full-time person per week. Default 40.

minutes_per_case.description: Average handling time per case, in minutes.

monthly_growth.description: Month-over-month change in weekly volume. 0.05 means 5% a month. Default 0.

months.description: Plan length in months when using monthly_growth. Default 12.

ramp_months.description: Months from start date to full productivity. Default 0.

shrinkage.description: Share of paid time not available for the work: PTO, sick time, training, meetings. 0.30 means 30%. Default 0.3.

start_month.description: First month of the plan as YYYY-MM, used only to label months.

target_occupancy.description: Share of available time you plan to keep people busy with the work. Default 0.85.

time_to_hire_months.description: Months from opening a requisition to the start date. Default 2.

weekly_volume.description: Weekly volume in month 1. Use with monthly_growth.

weekly_volume_by_month.description: Average weekly volume in each month of the plan, instead of weekly_volume and monthly_growth.

name: hiring_plan
title: Monthly hiring plan
